images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: On the ninth Tuesday the market clock in Ostrel struck six, and the stallholders on the riverside of the square began to unpack the same crates they had unpacked an hour before.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Devetega torka je tržna ura v Ostrelu odbila šest in prodajalci na rečni strani trga so začeli razkladati iste zaboje, ki so jih razložili uro prej.
